tbesh_html:
1) to oppress, suppress, treat violently, maltreat, vex, do wrong
1a) (Qal) to oppress, suppress
1b) (Hiphil) to treat violently, maltreat

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to rage or be violent; by implication, to suppress, to maltreat
strongs_1890.kjv_def: destroy, (thrust out by) oppress(-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.
